physicalNotes: Radius 0.17994469 Jupiter radii from Bonfanti et al. 2021 (2021A&A...646A.157B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...646A.157B/abstract): 12,864.6 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius.
